scientific_integrity: Exact analytical proof; rational symbolic checks and illustrative numerical trajectories; first public source date supplied by arXiv v1.
scientific_limitations: The exact power-Dulac cutoff is method-optimal, not proved dynamical sharpness. No global Hurwitz-Jacobian conclusion for enlarged parameter interval. Theorem is only for exact field and positive parameters; independent audit unperformed.
title: An optimal power-Dulac certificate extends the global two-cycle regime of a polynomial three-flow
